svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-11
svg.desc: Runtime beam and avatar safety changes merged with Git LFS runtime asset storage repair.
svg.text: 2026-08-11 - Beam safety and repository storage repair
main | commits fb10b85, 22573dc, 5fe427a, 9588a92, 1c32b8e | real merge kept explicit
Daily job
Join a runtime source fix with repository transport repair while keeping their responsibilities separate.
The code branch and asset/LFS branch meet at 5fe427a; the follow-up commits finish snapshot tracking.
BEFORE
Two separate failure modes were easy to conflate
Beam code could treat incomplete avatar data, dead actors, or ineligible targets as usable.
Large Unreal assets could appear as ordinary Git blobs or exceed GitHub's 100 MB file limit.
A runtime behavior problem and a repository storage problem can occur in the same merge,
but they require different guards and different validation.
split responsibilities at the merge
RUNTIME CODE BRANCH | fb10b85
Safe beam behavior
Checked avatar lookup and native interface dispatch.
CombatRules gate for primary and chain targets.
Dead-target pruning and eligible replacement acquisition.
Visual-only endpoints cannot consume damage chain slots.
ASSET/LFS BRANCH | 22573dc + FOLLOW-UP
Safe repository transport
2,745 runtime asset paths plus tracking files use LFS.
.uasset, .umap, and the oversized snapshot are covered.
Merge preserves code behavior and runtime content.
Snapshot follow-up tracks the 192,874,753-byte Control Rig export.
Code evidence: 25 beam/avatar tests passed.
Storage evidence: Git LFS fsck OK and snapshot restored.
